translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga bana ba babakala ba Kole.

content.text: Yave widi wunneni.
Ayi lutidi fuana mu tambula minzitusu
mu divula di Nzambi eto, mongo andi wunlongo.
Widi wu kitoko mu nangama kuandi,
khini yi ntoto wumvimba.
Mongo wu Sioni widi banga zitsongi zilutisi nangama zi Zafoni,
divula di ntinu wunneni.
Nzambi widi mu zinzo zi divula beni
wukimonisa niandi veka mu ba suamunu kiandi ki ngolo.
Mu thangu mintinu mifubikisa zingolo,
mu thangu midiatila va kimosi.
Mimona ayi misimina ;
mitina mu tsisi.
Lukhuku luba buila vana
ziphasi ziba mona zidedikini banga mianga
mieti mona nketo weka buta.
Ngeyo wuba bunga banga masuwa ma Talisi
mabungu mu phemo yeti totukila ku Esite.
Banga bu tuwila,
buawu bobo tumuenini mu divula di Yave,
nkua ngolo yoso ;
mu divula di Nzambi eto :
Nzambi wela kuvana luvovomo mu zithangu zioso.
Mu khati nzo aku, a Nzambi,
tueti yindula mu diambu di luzolo luaku lu ngolo.
Banga dizina diaku, a Nzambi !
Nzitusu aku widi nate mu sukisina ntoto.
Koko kuaku ku lubakala kuwedi busonga.
Mongo wu Sioni wulembo moni khini ;
mala ma Yuda malembo yangalala
mu diambu di zinzengolo ziaku.
Ludiata muyenda Sioni ayi lunzungidila,
ayi lutanga zinzo ziandi zizangama.
Lutala bumboti ziphangu ziandi ;
Lufiongunina zinzo ziandi
muingi luba samunina kuidi tsungi yinkuiza.
Bila Nzambi yayi niandi Nzambi eto
mu thangu yi kayimani ayi mu zithangu zioso.
Niandi wela ba ntuadisi eto nate ku tsuka.
